sources.description: claude/tfm-polish head; every gate except those below

adds only the ignored test diagnoses_pinned_nemotron_decision_14_time_step_clamp to tests/nemotron_h_artifacts.rs; Muse official reference, Nemotron bundle, smoke, and official gate ran from this clean tree
extends that diagnostic with official-row profiles and router margins; the diagnostic ran from this clean tree

host: Apple M3 Max, 96 GiB unified memory, macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), shared with desktop applications (about 12 GB resident)
harness: Each test ran in its own process from its prebuilt test binary (`TEST --ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads 1`) under `/usr/bin/time -l`, so peak memory is per process. The runner appended every output line except libtest's 'running 1 test' and blank lines, kept only the wall-clock and peak-memory-footprint lines of the time summary, and closed each process with an `== exit=` line.

watchdog.sampling: once per second: vm.swapusage, vm_stat Swapins, memory_pressure -Q free percentage
watchdog.first_attempt_policy: kill when swap grew by more than 3 GiB
watchdog.second_policy: kill on swap-ins above 1 GiB, free memory below 10%, or swap growth above 8 GiB
watchdog.policy: kill on swap-ins above 1 GiB counted only while free memory is below 30%, free memory below 10%, or swap growth above 8 GiB; used for the gpt-oss reference retry and all later gates
watchdog.reason_for_change: The first Qwen3.8 smoke was killed after macOS paged 3.5 GiB of idle compressed memory to swap with zero swap-ins and at least 32% free; swap-ins, not swap-outs, indicate thrashing. Later the host paged evicted application memory back at about 5.7 MiB/s with nothing of this replay running, so swap-ins are counted only under memory pressure.
watchdog.observation: Across the session swap usage grew from 2.5 GiB to a peak of about 11.6 GiB as idle application memory was paged out, and fell back as applications paged it in. No gate thrashed: every completed process stayed at or above 32% free memory with at most 87 MiB of swap-ins; the largest swap growth of a completed process was 6.1 GiB (Nemotron diagnostic), and no swap-ins occurred below 30% free after the final policy change.

notes: Experimental validation only: no checkpoint below is advertised as supported by this record.
Timings come from a host shared with other applications and are not performance measurements.
Binaries built at 8a4404a stayed in use after the two diagnostic commits, which change only tests/nemotron_h_artifacts.rs; each binary's listed source commit is its exact source.

The Muse official-reference gate binds its source: it requires a clean committed crate tree and exactly the std,metal,tokenizers features, so it ran from a dedicated binary at the clean commit 4f9502a.

Qwen3.8 and Qwen3-30B-A3B F32 logit digests differ from their pre-polish records although top-1 tokens and cached/stateless cosines are unchanged; the batched-execution, attention and DeltaNet changes alter reduction order. Their official or internal parity measures below decide acceptance, not bitwise identity.

aborted_attempts.diagnosis: Harness, not product: the first watchdog policy killed the process after 89 s when macOS paged 3.5 GiB of idle compressed memory to swap (zero swap-ins, free memory at least 32%). The retry under the swap-in policy passed.

Harness, not product: the gate refused to start because the worktree held this replay's untracked log and test file and the binary carried chat-templates; it requires a clean committed tree and exactly std,metal,tokenizers. The log moved outside the tree and a dedicated binary was built at the clean commit 4f9502a, which passed.

aborted_attempts.log_label: gpt-oss-20b full 24-block BF16 reference generation (Transformers 5.2.0, PyTorch 2.10.0, CPU, eager)
aborted_attempts.diagnosis: Harness, not product: the swap-in policy killed the generator after 326 s with free memory never below 90%. With nothing of this replay running, the host swapped in about 5.7 MiB/s as applications paged back memory that earlier gates had evicted, so swap-ins no longer indicated pressure. The policy then counted swap-ins only while free memory was below 30%; the generator's partial staging directory was removed and the retry passed.

calibrate each row's floor from measured F16 self-consistency
record expert selections in a new oracle and compare routing directly
